title: Back to Mum
description: Navigate back to tell Mum what you found

story: That note was concerning! We need to tell Mum about this.
Let's go back to the kitchen step by step.
First, go back to the garden using 'cd ..'
hints: Type 'cd ..' to go back to the garden.
💡 TIP: Press the UP arrow key to replay your previous command!

story: Use 'cd ..' again to go back to the house.
💡 TIP: Press the UP arrow key to replay your previous command!
hints: Type 'cd ..' to go back to the house.

story: Now go back into the kitchen to see Mum. 👩‍🍳
hints: Type 'cd kitchen' to go back to the kitchen.
